Tournament Bracket Maker

Build a single-elimination tournament bracket from any list of players or teams — automatic seeding, byes and round-by-round matchups.

–

📖 How to use

  1. Enter one player or team per line.
  2. Choose whether to shuffle the seeds.
  3. Press Build bracket to see every round from Round 1 to the Final.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What if my player count is not a power of 2?

Yes — the field is padded up to the next power of 2, and the extra slots become byes so top seeds advance automatically.

Can I randomize the seeding?

Tick the shuffle box to randomize seeds, or leave it off to keep your entry order as seeds 1, 2, 3...

What format is the bracket?

Single elimination: lose once and you are out. The bracket shows every round through to the final.

Is this private?

Yes, everything is generated locally in your browser.
